claims.population: Owerri consists of three local government areas, Owerri Municipal, Owerri North and Owerri West, and has an estimated population of 1,401,873 as of 2016.
claims.climate: Owerri has a tropical wet climate under the Koppen-Geiger system; rain falls for most months with a brief dry season, and the harmattan is noticeably less pronounced than in other Nigerian cities.
claims.economy: Owerri sits in the rain forest and produces yams, cassava, taro, corn, rubber and palm products, and sits on huge crude oil and natural gas reserves.
claims.food: One major food particular to the Owerri people is ofe owerri.
claims.tertiary: Owerri tertiary institutions include Federal Polytechnic, Nekede; Federal University of Technology Owerri; and Imo State University.
